text:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming.tail.p99 spiked above SLO in prod (p99=18.2s, p95=4.6s) across us-west-2; error budget burn: 12% in last 15m :rotating_light:

maria: seeing the same on dashboards, customers on streaming sessions reporting stalls/partial chunks. Paging oncall...

anya: I’m oncall, joining. Any obvious deploys?

maria: no deploys in last hour. API deploys are green. Spike aligns with increased auth latency from token-store.

raj: suspect auth tokenstore hitting DB rate limits and causing control-plane config fetches to queue; when control-plane delays, inference runtime blocks on feature flags and model routing — stalls streaming.

emily: logs show 429s from auth service at 2026-11-22T16:07Z, backoff retries pile up. snippet: 
```
2026-11-22T16:07:12Z ERROR auth: token_lookup failed status=429 msg="db: rate limit"
2026-11-22T16:07:13Z WARN controlplane: configfetch delay for client=svc-inference ms=14500
```

sofia: metrics: auth.latency.p99 jumped to 1.2s (was 90ms), token-store connections at 95% of pool. Controlplane queue length +300.

anya: immediate mitigations?\
raj: short term: 1) enable auth cache coalescing (reduces repeated token lookups), 2) flip feature flag 'ff.propagate_immediate' to false to stop config churn, 3) fallback inference path to cached-model-variant for streaming to avoid config checks.\
maria: agree. I’ll flip the feature flag and enable auth cache. Doing via console now.\
maria: `POST https://console.redwood.example/api/flags/ff.propagate_immediate/toggle` -> `{"state":"off","actor":"maria"}` -> response 200\
emily: I pushed auth-cache-coalesce as a runtime toggle: `kubectl -n auth set env deployment/auth-service AUTH_CACHE_COALESCE=true`\
dave: rolling fallback to cached-model-variant on routing layer. Command: 
```
./rctl route update inference --fallback cached-model-variant --policy=immediate
```
\sofia: routed ~30% traffic to fallback in canary, latency improved for those sessions (p99 dropped to 6.8s).\
anya: customers impacted? any major accounts complaining?\
maria: Support reports 6 customers saw stalls >10s; one enterprise stream timed out and retried. Logged in incident tracker with customer-impact tag.\
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20261122-1798003456 (severity: high). Pager duty: oncall=anya.\
raj: root cause hypothesis: auth token-store hitting DB request-rate-window due to a small hotkey and feature-flag propagation amplifying lookup churn. This causes controlplane to block requests for feature flags which inference runtime uses synchronously on stream start.\
emily: evidence: spike in featureflag fetches graph showing fanout at 16:06Z (x5 baseline).\
anya: next steps for mitigation leads: 
- auth: raj/emily to increase token-store request window and add temporary token-cache TTL bump (+30s).
- controlplane: maria to disable immediate propagations and throttle configfetches.
- routing: dave to expand fallback to 60% and monitor error budget.
- support: sofia to notify impacted customers with ETA.\
raj: done: increased tokenstore window by setting `TOKENSTORE_MAX_QPS=1500` on auth-db-proxy (applied). Also TTL bump: `AUTH_TOKEN_TTL=30s` on auth-service.\
emily: controlplane throttle change: `PATCH /controlplane/configfetch?rate=200/s` -> 200 OK.\
dave: expanding fallback to 60% now, will watch for model-quality regressions.\
sofia: notif sent to impacted customers: short note, working on mitigation, next update in 30m.\
anya: monitoring: please post p95/p99 in 5m.\
(5m passes)\
emily: p99 down from 18.2s -> 9.1s, p95 from 4.6s -> 2.1s. Controlplane queue fell by 70%.\
maria: auth 429s stopped after TTL bump and cache coalesce. Tokenstore pool utilization now 60%.\
anya: good progress. This is a live mitigation — we need follow-ups: 
- permanent fix for hotkey on tokenstore, investigate why ttl short; instrument hotkey detection (owner: raj)
- make propagate_immediate less chatty and add splay to feature flag propagation (owner: maria)
- add a fallback async featureflag path for streaming (owner: dave)
- postmortem and customer RCA (owner: anya)\
dave: will open route-change PR to make fallback policy adaptive instead of static.\
raj: will run a smoke test for tokenstore after we provision additional DB read capacity.\
sofia: support will follow up with impacted customers with a detailed timeline once we have postmortem draft.\
incident-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff scheduled in 30m.\
anya: Handoff summary for night team: 
- current status: mitigations applied (featureflag propagation off, auth cache + TTL, fallback routing at 60%). Latency improved but not fully recovered to SLO.
- risks: if tokenstore QPS surges again, controlplane queue can re-grow.
- next actions: raj to complete DB scaling and hotkey mitigation, maria to implement propagate splay, dave to make fallback adaptive, emily to validate no regressions to config consistency.
- contacts: raj, maria, dave (eng-oncall).

maria: adding runbook note: `runbook/streaming_latency_hotkey.md` entry with steps we used.\
anya: thanks team. I’m going to hand this to night oncall at 23:00 UTC. Leaving a pinned message in incident channel with this thread link.\
sofia: will update customers after handoff.\
emily: logging full timeline and metrics to INC-20261122-1798003456 ticket.\
incident-bot: Incident INC-20261122-1798003456 updated: status=mitigated, severity=high -> monitoring.\
anya: closing active paging. If anything degrades, page oncall immediately.\
maria: thanks all. Postmortem owners assigned: anya (write), raj (root cause), maria (mitigation design), dave (fallback design).\
sofia: note for postmortem: include customer messages and support timeline.\
emily: capturing logs/graphs and will attach to postmortem.\
(END of thread)
